One script, seventeen short storyboards: the scenes ProteinMotion renders beside its
documentation snippets. Each is a function; run them all or name the ones you want:

```bash
uv run python docs/examples/timeline/scripts/docs_examples.py out_dir
uv run python docs/examples/timeline/scripts/docs_examples.py out_dir callout_scene surface
```

Scenes whose subject Molecular Nodes cannot animate yet (write-on text, 3D highlights,
hydrogen bonds, charge contacts, deformation) show what can be shown and say what is
missing in a comment.
